授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
本科目は北海道大学共同資源工学専攻にて実施される集中講義
This course introduces the state of the art researches and technologies related to Economic Geology, Exploration Geophysics, Geothermics, Energy Resources Engineering, Resources Production and Safety Engineering, Rock Mechanics and Mining Macinery and Mineral Processing, Recycling and Environmental Remediation. This course enhances the development of students’ skill and knowledge related to Economic Geology, Exploration Geophysics, Geothermics, Energy Resources Engineering, Resources Production and Safety Engineering, Rock Mechanics and Mining Machinery and Mineral Processing, Recycling and Environmental Remediation.
Theory and principle should be sufficiently understood.
Examples and exercises should be perfectly solved.
